request_ref: Next bounded component after R1-SQLITE-IMPORTER-001; review before implementation
system_result: Validated current/pinned read, original availability, stable paginated history and receipt recovery usable through Commander without changing canonical data.
application_result: Synthetic local CLI/helper for bank.get, collection.get, bank.original, bank.history and receipt.get; bank.search explicitly unsupported until separate index task.

acceptance_checks.check: Strict bounded request parser plus closed BANK_QUERY.schema validation; four R1 types and exact operations; bounded identity-preserving OK/ERROR envelopes; unknown protocol/fields/mode, bool-as-integer and unsupported bank.search reject without fallback. Explicit request/depth/response/member/metadata/stream/time/SQL-work budgets and closed result schema; reject limits without truncation.

Existing trusted known-format DB only, no create/import/intake/fetch; app-owned fixed roots and read snapshot. Each current result resolves once to pinned ref with validated exact document, accepted_at/commit_sequence. Wrong type/object/revision and malformed or corrupt retained data fail explicitly.

collection.get keeps exact member order and pinned refs, without latest substitution or recursive expansion. Missing member visible as unavailable under documented result policy, never omitted/replaced.

bank.original pinned Asset maps to its retained command/path/hash; bytes stream to exclusive app-owned protected output, never caller destination or unbounded JSON. Verify before publishing successful handle, cleanup partial owned outputs on fault; locator is metadata-only, no network. Artifact lifecycle and safe rendering boundary documented. Output handle protection lasts through API context; CLI-created export persists privately but later consumers verify returned size/hash. Partial files removed, accepted outputs retained without automatic cleanup.

bank.history newest-first by accepted commit sequence, bounded limit/offset under explicit snapshot. Null selects durable sequence once, supplied unavailable sequence errors; paging consistent across concurrent later update and process restart. Indexed reads and bounded integrity work, no whole-history/BLOB load.

receipt.get returns original accepted receipt/actual hash, exact expected hash comparison; missing receipt not proof failed command. Diagnostic attempt if unavailable explicitly unavailable, never fabricated or substituted for canonical receipt. Current writer does not persist attempt history; output explicitly states not_recorded_by_current_writer, not fabricated latest failure.

CLI uses controlled existing Store adapter without changing accepted importer semantics/DDL. Demonstrate save→receipt→pinned read→update→old reopen, intake removal, restart, busy/unavailable/integrity/errors/limits and stable history in native synthetic fixtures. No search/UI/release/private real Bank acceptance.

Preserve old review/issues/history, record per-case native evidence, source/baseline guards and readback; mandatory unavailable requirement blocks completion. Review card and clarify output/attempt boundaries before implementation.

pre_execution_questions.question: How to access protected importer integrity reads in one consistent read transaction without exposing write capability?
pre_execution_questions.proposal: A reviewed read adapter using existing verified metadata/BLOB primitives; preserve immutable writer and fixed DDL. Select bounded connection lifetime and failure semantics before coding.

pre_execution_questions.question: How to represent large verified originals and latest diagnostic attempts?
pre_execution_questions.proposal: Generate protected owned output handles with explicit lifecycle and plain metadata; if no durable attempt log exists, declare latest diagnostic unavailable rather than inventing it. Record any remaining contract gap in the review.

boundaries.owned_resources: Synthetic temporary private NTFS DB/output roots and owned CLI processes only
boundaries.recovery: SQLite may restore own hot journal before a logical read; no application commits/manual journal deletion. Physical recovery is documented separately from logical read-only behavior.

next_action: Implement reviewed read adapter/CLI locally, portable tests then guarded Windows transfer; native checks pending.

implementation_decisions.result_validation: Closed supplemental result.schema.json under experiment; existing request protocol and persisted schema unchanged
implementation_decisions.history: Global durable commit snapshot, indexed per-object newest-first pages; no COUNT(*) of entire history; limit+1 rows for has_more
implementation_decisions.integrity: Verify trusted commit/receipt/revision/inventory metadata and selected document bytes; collection checks at most256 direct member targets, no recursive expansion; receipt.get verifies entire bounded original command
implementation_decisions.diagnostics: latest_diagnostic_attempt availability=not_recorded_by_current_writer; no full unindexed scan of attempt_receipts
implementation_decisions.original_lifetime: App creates private unique export directory and fixed original.bin, verifies streamed hash then readback, holds protected read handles while API context lives. CLI leaves verified private export bytes after exit; later consumer must compare returned hash/size. No caller destination, no rendering or auto-fetch. Explicit cleanup later, no canonical deletion.
